description: This file defines the API and data structures for a dynamic string vector (`strvec`) in C, including functions for initialization, modification, and memory management of string arrays.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure, setting up its internal array and counters.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string onto the end of the strvec array.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes an allocated string onto the array, taking ownership of the string.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string and pushes it onto the array, combining string formatting and insertion.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a list of strings onto the array, terminated by NULL.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes a null-terminated array of strings onto the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the array with new strings, allowing insertion or deletion.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specific index with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the string at a specified index from the array.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the array.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string by whitespace into the array; does not handle quoted arguments.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the array and resets it.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array from the struct, returning it for external management.
